text: 金十数据9月27日讯，为做好中秋国庆假期安全防范工作，国务院安委办、国家防减救灾办、应急管理部日前部署各地假期期间分级分行业派出工作组，采取“四不两直”方式，深入重点行业领域、重点场所、重点部位开展暗访检查，推动落实各项安全责任措施。9月26日，国务院安委办副主任、应急管理部副部长宋元明视频抽查北京、辽宁、山东、四川、陕西等5个省（直辖市）暗访检查工作开展情况，推动各地进一步强化安全防范措施，全力保障中秋国庆假期安全稳定。
text_en: Jinshi Data, September 27 — To ensure safety precautions during the Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day holiday, the Work Safety Committee Office of the State Council, the National Disaster Prevention, Reduction and Relief Office, and the Ministry of Emergency Management recently deployed work teams across regions and industries during the holiday period, using the "four noes and two straights" method to conduct unannounced inspections in key industries, key venues and key locations, and to push for the implementation of various safety responsibility measures. On September 26, Song Yuanming, deputy director of the Work Safety Committee Office of the State Council and vice minister of the Ministry of Emergency Management, conducted video spot checks on the unannounced inspection work in five provinces or municipalities including Beijing, Liaoning, Shandong, Sichuan and Shaanxi, pushing localities to further strengthen safety precautions and make every effort to ensure safety and stability during the Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day holiday.
